description: Elektro polnilnice v občini Sevnica is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA SEVNICA. The database contains information on the location, ownership and operation regime of charging stations for electric vehicles in the municipality of Sevnica. Coverage: OBČINA SEVNICA. The portal shows the English title as "Electric charging stations in the municipality of Sevnica" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA SEVNICA. Its keywords include električni avtomobil, električna vozila, elektro polnilnice, električne polnilnice, elektro vozila. The listing shows 6 download or service links in HTML, KML, XLSX, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
